blocks.x: Cyber Resilience & Threat Command: the composed architecture, the platforms underneath and the metric the program is judged on.
The problem this solution exists for
Security programs accumulate tools without outcomes; recovery is untested; board reporting is anecdotal; AI systems add an undefended surface.
Our approach

We run the resilience program end-to-end: crown-jewel recovery engineering, zero-trust migration in tiers, detection coverage against ATT&CK, AI-endpoint security, and an exercise calendar whose evidence feeds the board pack.
Components

items: Trust-tier sequencing with measured residual trust
Prompt-injection defense and red-teaming for AI estate
Tabletops and fire drills with tracked findings

blocks.x: Platform stack

The solution runs on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass: Security controls for people, machines and models, with evidence collected continuously. Model governance your risk committee and regulator can review.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

blocks.x: What you get

items: Reference architecture adapted to your estate, with the integration contracts itemized.
The composed capability live on bounded scope, with audit evidence produced automatically.
Runbooks, SLO catalog and the named-pod accountability chain for production.
Baseline pack, measurement method and the quarterly review template your finance team signs.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

The readiness checklist covers three items: source-system access under your security policy, an operating team willing to trial the new workflow, and agreement on the baseline measurement method before work starts.
Proof

items: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails: 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
DORA-grade resilience posture: third-party and incident evidence automated

blocks.x: Industry fit

Deployed across Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Energy & Utilities, Public Sector & Government, Manufacturing & Industrial. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

Below is the delivery cadence for this capability — the same pattern on every engagement. The first quarter of the rhythm is verification: weeks 1–2 measure the current metric with your team and lock it by signature. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with your control owner receiving evidence weekly. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and the measured delta against the signed baseline. Gates are binding: miss one and the program stops or redirects with a documented decision.
